about: Accelevation Holdings Corp. designs, manufactures, and installs power distribution and white space infrastructure products for mission-critical environments. Its products and services include infrastructure solutions, such as SkyBridge modular platform, techFrame steel structures and conveyance, thermal management products, and installation and maintenance services; and power products, such as remote power panels, including high-density remote power panels, as well as branch circuit whips, power distribution units and related monitoring, and upstream distribution products. The company serves hyperscaler, colocation, and data center customers. Accelevation Holdings Corp. was founded in 2017 and is based in Miamisburg, Ohio.
